 Meesho block deal: SoftBank-backed entity likely to sell 1% stake worth Rs 1,174 crore
 SECTIONS Meesho block deal: SoftBank-backed entity likely to sell 1% stake worth Rs 1,174 crore By Kumar Gaurav , ETMarkets.com Last Updated: Nov 12, 2026, 08:30:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis SoftBank-backed SVF II Meerkat may sell a 1% stake in Meesho through a Rs 1,174 crore block deal. The development comes as Meesho reports narrowing losses, rising revenue and strong user growth.
 Agencies SoftBank-backed investor plans a potential Meesho stake sale as the e-commerce platform reports improved quarterly performance, growing users and completes its Kirana Club acquisition.
 SoftBank Group-backed investment vehicle SVF II Meerkat (DE) LLC is likely to divest around 1% stake in e-commerce platform Meesho through a block deal worth Rs 1,174 crore, according to reports.
 The floor price for the transaction has been set at Rs 246.23 per share, representing a discount of around 3.1% to Meesho's closing price of Rs 254.15 apiece on Thursday.
SVF II Meerkat (DE) LLC held 31,63,60,762 shares, representing a 6.84% stake in Meesho, at the end of the September quarter of FY27, according to exchange data. Following the proposed transaction, its shareholding is expected to decline to around 5.8%, assuming no other transactions take place in the interim.
 ALSO READ: Vodafone Idea Q2 Results: Loss widens to Rs 5,975 crore, revenue rises 6% YoY; ARPU jumps to Rs 198 
 Meesho Q2 results 
 Live Events
 Meesho reported a 67.8% year-on-year reduction in its consolidated net loss to Rs 132.45 crore in the September quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), compared with a loss of Rs 411.36 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year. Revenue from operations increased 34.4% year-on-year to Rs 4,131.58 crore in Q2FY27 from Rs 3,073.67 crore in Q2FY26. Total expenses rose 23.8% to Rs 4,382.27 crore from Rs 3,540.44 crore in the year-ago quarter.
 On a sequential basis, the company's net loss remained broadly unchanged at Rs 132.45 crore, compared with Rs 132.84 crore in the June quarter. Revenue from operations increased 11.3% quarter-on-quarter to Rs 4,131.58 crore from Rs 3,712.81 crore.
 EBITDA loss stood at Rs 229 crore, compared with Rs 225 crore in the preceding quarter.
The e-commerce marketplace also reported growth across key operating metrics. Annual transacting users increased 21% year-on-year to 284 million, while last-twelve-month purchase frequency rose 7% to 10.4. First-time buyers increased 16% sequentially, and annual transacting sellers grew 60% year-on-year to 1.13 million.
 Meesho acquires 92.74% stake in Kirana Club 
In a separate development, Meesho announced on November 7 that it had completed the first and second tranches of the acquisition of a 92.74% stake in Singapore-based Kirana Club Pte. Ltd. and its Indian step-down subsidiary, Retail Pulse Labs Private Limited (RPLPL).
The acquisition was completed for an aggregate consideration of Rs 186.71 crore. Following the transaction, Kirana Club became a subsidiary of Meesho, while RPLPL became its step-down subsidiary.
